citation.description: Parametrized test covering both 'python' (src/main.py) and 'typescript' (src/main.ts) fixtures, running the full metrics CLI with fake scc/lizard/jscpd binaries and asserting code_health values for both languages.

criteria.criterion: `code_health` metrics computed via the analyzer stack (scc/lizard/jscpd) for a Python client AND at least one non-Python client (e.g. Go or TS).

citation.description: metrics = ["lizard>=1.23"] — only lizard is in the optional extra. Core dependencies unchanged (pyyaml, jsonschema, referencing). lizard_complexity.py uses guard_import which returns Unavailable when lizard is absent.

criteria.criterion: Zero new HARD deps in rebar core; analyzer + tools live behind `pip install rebar[metrics]`; core-only install reports code_health as Unavailable with a clear reason.

citation.description: CodeHealthConfig dataclass with scan_roots: list[str] and size_cap: int | None — both per-project config. Search for hardcoded paths in src/rebar/metrics returned no matches.

criteria.criterion: No hardcoded `src/rebar` / `.github/module-size-limit.txt`; scan root + size policy are per-project config.

citation.description: test_foreign_repo_honest_unavailable creates a Go file, runs with empty PATH, and asserts the unavailable reason contains neither 'Errno' nor 'module-size-limit.txt'. scc_loc.py and jscpd_dup.py catch FileNotFoundError/OSError and return structured Unavailable.

criteria.criterion: Missing analyzer/tool -> honest `Unavailable`, never fabricated zeros and never a leaked exception string.

citation.description: module_size_distribution and oversized_module_count accept size_cap: int | None; when None, cap-related fields (near_cap_count, over_cap_count) are omitted/None. Cap is per-project config via code_health.size_cap.

criteria.criterion: Module-size cap re-expressed as an optional policy over the LOC signal.
